purpose: Teach: あいかわらず/おまかせ/さがし/わかれ/しるし/さながら/すごし/段々

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんはあいかわらずお元気よ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's doing as well as ever.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle reassurance in her tone. A small smile in her voice—the kind of thing you say to a child who worries about the people he loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日のおやつ、ママのおまかせでいいよ
lines.en: Mom, can I just have whatever you decide for today's snack?
lines.style: Bright and eager, trusting. No hesitation. The confidence of a child who knows his mother's choices are safe. Quick pace, open.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお仕事道具をさがしてあげてね
lines.en: Sho, could you help Dad find his work things?
lines.style: Practical, warm redirect. Matter-of-fact but not rushed. The tone of someone asking a favor they know he's ready for. A small vote of confidence wrapped in an everyday request.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達とわかれる時、寂しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I felt lonely when I had to say goodbye to my friend today.
lines.style: Quiet and tentative. Testing whether it's okay to say this out loud. Small voice, careful. The honesty of a young child who trusts but isn't quite sure if his sadness is allowed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご褒美のしるしにシール貼りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's put a sticker on your chart as a reward, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle and encouraging. Warm without being theatrical. The practicality of turning sadness into something small and concrete—a sticker, a mark of progress. Soft, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの大きな手がさながら宝物のようだったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's big hands felt like treasure to me.
lines.style: Soft and reverent. Speaking slowly, as if the words are delicate. Not childish wonder—something deeper. The kind of quiet that shows he's been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんはお元気にすごしてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma's doing well and keeping busy.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. The warm competence of a mother updating her child on the people who matter. No urgency—just presence. Like she's sitting across from him and he can trust every word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノが段々上手になってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm getting better at piano, little by little.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Not boasting—more a private satisfaction he's sharing. A small lift at the end, like he's offering her something he's worked for. Genuine.
